# vendor/ — intentionally not committed

Downloaded vendor CAD lived here. Excluded because the Pololu STEP files carry
no stated license (redistribution unverified) and the FreeCAD-library file is
CC-BY-3.0 (attribution required). Re-download:

- nema17.step  — Adafruit_CAD_Parts, "324 NEMA-17 Stepper Motor.step" (MIT)
- servo_s3003.step — FreeCAD-library, Electrical Parts/Servos/Futaba3003 (CC-BY-3.0)
- a4988.step   — https://www.pololu.com/file/0J1223/ (no license stated)
- drv8825.step — https://www.pololu.com/file/0J1226/ (no license stated)

Visual placeholders only. Never cut mating features from them —
see skills/rover-design/references/provenance.md.
